data.name: Granny Remake: 2
data.detailed_description:
Every corner is a dead end. Every corridor is a trap. Welcome to a shifting nightmare that changes every time you dare to play.

In this co-op survival horror, you and your friends wake up in a grim prison cell on a decaying, isolated farm. To survive, you must navigate a massive, procedurally generated mansion where the layout—corridors, rooms, and pathways—shifts with every single match. Memorizing the map won't save you here.

Do you have what it takes to escape, or will you take control of the horror and hunt down your friends?

KEY FEATURES

  • The House is Shifting: No more safe zones. The mansion’s layout changes dynamically every time you play. Corridors lead to new dead ends, rooms swap places, and your escape route is never where you left it. Adapt or die in a living, breathing maze.

  • Co-op Survival or Asymmetrical PvP: Team up with up to 4 friends to escape the madness together. Or, turn against them—step into the shoes of the brutal, grotesque Grandparents and use traps and sheer terror to stop their escape.

  • Explore the Rotting Farm: Sneak through suffocating cornfields, cross muddy swamps, and search the stench of the pigpen. Every area hides the keys to your freedom - and the monsters waiting to tear you apart.

  • Multiple Escape Routes: There is no single way out. Hotwire the rusty motorcycle, ram through the gates in a truck, or solve the house's darkest secrets to slip away unnoticed.

  • Procedural Puzzles & Chaos: It’s not just the walls that move. Item locations, key placements, and puzzle solutions are fully randomized. You’ll need sharp wits and communication to solve the shifting riddles of the farm.

  • Terrifying Customization: Stand out in the dark. Unlock and equip unsettling cosmetic items, masks, and outfits to personalize your survivor - or make your killers look even more nightmarish.

The Grandparents are listening. The walls are moving. Can you find the way out before the layout shifts again?

data.short_description: Survive a terrifying farm in this co-op multiplayer horror! Hide in cornfields, solve procedural puzzles, and escape before the nightmarish Grandparents find you. Or, play as the killers and hunt your friends down in asymmetrical PvP madness. No two escapes are ever the same.
data.supported_languages: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 30 60-70 Ti (8GB) or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 7 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Apple M2 Pro
  • Graphics: Apple M2 Pro GPU
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Apple M4 Pro
  • Graphics: Apple M4 Pro GPU

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of blood splatters and puddles on the floors and walls to build a tense horror atmosphere. It features intense horror elements, jumpscares, and scenes where the player is attacked and killed by an enemy, resulting in a fade-to-black screen.
